title: NAIF SPICE generic kernel set for lunar surface geometry
summary: Leap seconds, planetary and lunar ephemeris (DE440, short span), lunar orientation (binary PCK) and lunar frame definitions (MOON_PA / MOON_ME), plus the generic text PCK. Required for Sun and Earth geometry as seen from the lunar surface.
provider: NASA Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility (NAIF), JPL

files.name: naif0012.tls
files.description: Leap seconds kernel (LSK): UTC ↔ ephemeris time.

files.name: pck00011.tpc
files.description: Generic text PCK: IAU body radii and orientation models.

files.name: de440s.bsp
files.description: Planetary and lunar ephemeris DE440, short time span (SPK).

files.name: moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc
files.description: High-accuracy lunar orientation (principal-axis frame) consistent with DE440 (binary PCK).

files.name: moon_de440_250416.tf
files.description: Lunar frames kernel (FK) defining MOON_PA_DE440, MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 and the generic MOON_PA / MOON_ME aliases.

spatial.coverage: Ephemeris time span defined by the SPK (DE440 short-span version)

units: SPICE conventions: km, km/s, seconds past J2000 TDB. LUNARIS converts to SI metres at its API boundary.
citation: Acton, C. H. (1996). Ancillary data services of NASA's Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility. Planetary and Space Science, 44(1), 65–70. doi:10.1016/0032-0633(95)00107-7. Park, R. S., Folkner, W. M., Williams, J. G., & Boggs, D. H. (2021). The JPL Planetary and Lunar Ephemerides DE440 and DE441. The Astronomical Journal, 161(3), 105. doi:10.3847/1538-3881/abd414
usage: NAIF generic kernels are publicly available. Cite SPICE (Acton 1996) and the ephemeris (Park et al. 2021).

verification.note: URLs, byte sizes and SHA-256 values confirmed on 2026-11-04 by an independent session with direct access to naif.jpl.nasa.gov (files downloaded and hashed; de440s.bsp MD5 also matched NAIF's aa_checksums.txt). Not re-checked from the LUNARIS development environment, where NASA hosts are blocked. The previous FK moon_de440_220930.tf was superseded (moved to a_old_versions/) by moon_de440_250416.tf.

notes: Kernels are stored under data/kernels/<dataset-id>/. A SPICE meta-kernel that furnishes them in the correct order is a Milestone 03 deliverable.

moon_de440_250416.tf keeps the frame names MOON_PA, MOON_ME, MOON_PA_DE440 (ID 31008) and MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (ID 31009) but changed the generic alias IDs (MOON_PA 31010→31000, MOON_ME 31011→31001). LUNARIS refers to frames by name only and never hard-codes frame ID integers.
MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 realizes the Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame consistently with the DE421-based ME frame used by LRO/LOLA products ('MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421' in LOLA labels).
DE442 (de442s.bsp) is published, but NAIF publishes no DE442-consistent lunar orientation PCK or FK; LUNARIS keeps the internally consistent DE440 lunar set.
de440s.bsp covers a reduced time span compared with de440.bsp; confirm the span covers the mission analysis windows.
